browse.empty_hint: Try removing filters, widening the period or using broader terms.
search.error_rate_limit: OpenAlex free daily limit reached. A free key, pasted into Settings → OpenAlex key, raises that limit. The app keeps working without one — the limit resets in a few hours.
browse.error_page_limit: {fonte} allows browsing up to 10,000 results per search. This search has more than that, but the following pages cannot be opened. Refine the search with the filters on the side to reach what you are looking for, or import the full set — importing has no such limit and brings every record in for analysis.
settings.openalex_key_hint: Leave blank to use the default free access. A free key (openalex.org) raises the daily request limit.
ai.onboarding_intro: The AI uses your own key, created by you and stored only on your machine. Groq's free tier covers normal Blicsa usage. Blicsa charges nothing and handles no payments.
ai.key_empty: Paste the key before saving — the field is empty.
ai.key_invalid: Key rejected by Groq. Check that you copied the whole key, without spaces, and that it is still active in the console.
ai.key_offline: No connection to Groq. The key may well be correct — check your internet and try again.
ai.key_rate_limit: Groq usage limit reached. The key is valid; wait a few minutes and try again.
ai.key_error: Groq responded with an unexpected error. Try again shortly.
